pieces:code-block.title: Code Block
pieces:code-block.description: A stateless numbered code figure with an optional filename and one readable dark media treatment.

pieces:logo-cloud.title: Logo Cloud
pieces:logo-cloud.description: One quiet responsive logo arrangement with an optional Marker introduction and no cosmetic display variants.

pieces:notification-feed-item.title: Notification Feed Item
pieces:notification-feed-item.description: A flat activity row with optional icon, supporting metadata, time, and semantic tone for a caller-owned feed.

pieces:pricing-plan-grid.title: Pricing Plan Grid
pieces:pricing-plan-grid.description: The one square repeated-plan arrangement with caller-composed actions, a single optional highlight, and automatic responsive columns.

pieces:release-table.title: Release Table
pieces:release-table.description: Release history that automatically uses a table on wide screens and a ruled list on small screens, with no representation prop.

pieces:schedule-list.title: Schedule List
pieces:schedule-list.description: One ruled agenda arrangement with a time gutter, status dot, optional description, and plain empty state.

pieces:state-message.title: State Message
pieces:state-message.description: The shared plain-language message arrangement for empty, error, offline, permission, and maintenance states.

pieces:status-history-strip.title: Status History Strip
pieces:status-history-strip.description: One ruled uptime history display with operational, degraded, outage, and no-data states plus an accessible text summary.

pieces:terminal-window.title: Terminal Window
pieces:terminal-window.description: A stateless command and output figure with one dark media treatment and restrained terminal chrome.

pieces:upload-file-row.title: Upload File Row
pieces:upload-file-row.description: A square file-status row that composes the shared progress Component and caller-owned actions without inventing upload behavior.
